tools.name: inbox_setup
tools.title: Set up the agent inbox
tools.description: Create the agent and its email inbox, or report how far setup got. Call with no arguments to see status and a suggested owner email. Ask the user for an agent name and address before creating; pass agent_name and handle together. Pass email only after the user confirms the address — a confirmation link goes out, and a later call with no arguments says whether they opened it. A name never changes an existing agent, and a handle never moves an existing mailbox; pass handle alone to finish a mailbox that was not created. This tool does not replace an email that is already confirmed.

agent_name.description: What the agent is called (up to 60 characters). Required with handle to create.

handle.description: Mailbox local-part the user chose, such as "atlas". Letters, digits and hyphens. Required with agent_name to create.

email.description: The owner's email to confirm. Confirm the suggested address from a no-argument call with the user before passing it.

tools.name: channel_add
tools.title: Add a channel
tools.description: Connect Telegram or Slack for the account owner. Each call says where things stand and gives the one next step, usually a link they finish in their own browser. It never waits for them: give them the link, then call it again after they finish. Never ask for a bot token or a Slack token; the link collects those. For the owner's email, use inbox_setup. For anyone else, use contact_invite.

tools.name: inbox_send
tools.title: Send an inbox message
tools.description: Start a conversation with one or more contacts. Leave kind out for a plain message, which returns once it is delivered; ask, approve or choose waits for the answer. Before you send, call inbox_list with filter "unread" so you do not miss a conversation a person started.

kind.description: Leave out for a plain message that needs no answer. ask: a free-text answer; approve: Approve/Deny buttons; choose: one of options.

to.description: Contact id, email address, or up to 50 of them. With inbox_send, omit to reach the account owner. With inbox_reply, these are the only contacts who may answer; one who is not in a direct conversation gets it in their own chat too, and the answer comes back to this conversation.

from.description: Attribution label shown to the person, such as "deploy-bot".

ttl_seconds.description: How long a question remains answerable, in seconds (default 86400, max 432000).

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the answer now, in seconds (default 45).

icon.description: Slack-only card icon: MCP catalog id, display name, or an HTTPS URL. Ignored on other channels.

extra_actions.description: Extra approve buttons after Approve and Deny (approve only, max 4).

options.description: Required for choose. Each choice is a label or an object with a stable id and label.

tools.name: inbox_reply
tools.title: Reply in a conversation
tools.description: Send into an existing conversation. Leave kind out for a plain message; ask, approve or choose waits for the answer. A reply goes out on the conversation's channel, so it has no via option.

kind.description: Leave out for a plain message that needs no answer. ask: a free-text answer; approve: Approve/Deny buttons; choose: one of options.

to.description: Contact id, email address, or up to 50 of them. With inbox_send, omit to reach the account owner. With inbox_reply, these are the only contacts who may answer; one who is not in a direct conversation gets it in their own chat too, and the answer comes back to this conversation.

anyone_may_answer.description: When true with conversation, anyone in it may answer, including when the conversation already has a contact. A conversation with no contact already lets everyone in it answer.

from.description: Attribution label shown to the person, such as "deploy-bot".

ttl_seconds.description: How long a question remains answerable, in seconds (default 86400, max 432000).

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the answer now, in seconds (default 45).

icon.description: Slack-only card icon: MCP catalog id, display name, or an HTTPS URL. Ignored on other channels.

extra_actions.description: Extra approve buttons after Approve and Deny (approve only, max 4).

options.description: Required for choose. Each choice is a label or an object with a stable id and label.

tools.name: inbox_wait
tools.title: Wait for an answer
tools.description: Keep waiting for the answer to an earlier ask, approve or choose that had no answer yet. Call it again while the result says the request is still open.

id.description: The id from the earlier result.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the answer now, in seconds (default 45).

tools.name: contact_invite
tools.title: Invite a person
tools.description: Get a link that lets another person connect their chat app, so you can reach them too. Nothing is sent for you: give the link to the user to pass on. Afterwards reach them with the id you chose here.

id.description: A short id for the person, such as "alice". You use it later as `to`.

tools.name: contact_list
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the people you can reach, with the id to pass as `to`. Your operator is marked (you). When the result ends with a cursor, call it again with after to see the rest before you decide someone is not there.

tools.name: inbox_list
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List the conversations in the agent's inbox. People can message the agent first: call this with filter "unread" before you send, so you see new conversations. Conversations with strangers are hidden unless senders is "all". Showing a conversation does not mark it read; any send into it does.

filter.description: Unread conversations, read ones, or both (default all).

status.description: Open conversations, resolved ones, or both (default open).

senders.description: Conversations a contact has written in, or all of them, strangers included (default contacts).

after.description: Cursor from a previous page (the last conversation id).

wait_seconds.description: Hold the request up to this many seconds until a conversation matches (max 25, default 0).

tools.name: inbox_show
tools.title: Show a conversation
tools.description: Show the messages in a conversation. Looking at it does not mark it read — use inbox_read or send a reply for that. People and messages are labelled contact or stranger.

limit.description: How many recent messages to return (default 20).

before.description: Message id cursor for older pages.

tools.name: inbox_read
tools.title: Mark a conversation read
tools.description: Mark a conversation read without sending a reply. Showing a conversation does not mark it read.

tools.name: inbox_resolve
tools.title: Resolve a conversation
tools.description: Mark a conversation resolved. It opens again when anyone writes in it. Use after you have finished with it.
